auth_notes: Supports OAuth2 and personal access tokens generated from the Gumroad advanced settings.

auth.quote: If you're writing some custom code you need to run with your Gumroad account, all you need is an access token. Your access token is used in the request header of every request to the API

access.quote: First, sign in to your Gumroad account. Then, go to advanced settings. Here, you'll see a form to create a new application.

api.quote: Built against Gumroad API v2 (the public, stable surface)

mcp.quote: MCP server for the Gumroad API. Drive your store from Claude Desktop or Cursor.

verdict.quote: With your access token in hand, head back to our API documentation for a list of endpoints the API makes available.

name: Gumroad
queries: Gumroad API access pricing plan developer

reasons.auth: The API supports Bearer tokens for direct access and OAuth2 (via 'Sign in with Gumroad' and Redirect URIs) for third-party applications. Bearer tokens are the primary method for simple integrations and CLI usage.
reasons.access: Developers can self-serve by creating an application in their Gumroad account and manually generating an access token for their own account without any approval process or cost.
reasons.mcp: There are multiple community-built MCP servers (e.g., Contrite42/gumroad-mcp-server, keithah/gumroad-mcp) available on GitHub, but no official MCP server is documented by Gumroad.
reasons.verdict: Public documentation is available, credentials can be generated immediately for free, and the API is accessible via REST and CLI, allowing a toolkit to be built today.
